title: Anemic API Contracts Mirroring Relational Hierarchy
pattern: Designing API route hierarchies or response models to mirror the nested relational layout of database tables.
why_bad: It exposes relational details and forces client applications to understand complex database join relationships. This results in chatty API communications (N+1 HTTP calls) and high coupling.
detection: Nested REST route designs with 3 or more levels of sub-resources matching database primary-foreign key hierarchies.
counterexample: Generic relational administration tools or SQL execution panels. Mark as `Context-dependent`.
source: *Implementing Domain-Driven Design* by Vaughn Vernon (Chapter 14, p. 197-199).
